rowJSON.title: Organization administrator
rowJSON.description: R on the project tables of the organization; CRUD on generic tables, catalogs, users, members and permissions

rowJSON.title: Project manager
rowJSON.description: full CRUD on the data of the project; RC on the catalogs; given at the organization level: may create projects

rowJSON.title: Project curator
rowJSON.description: R on all; given at the organization level: may create projects

rowJSON.title: Project member
rowJSON.description: derived: a person on a Time line as Accountable, Consulted or Informed reads the project

rowJSON.title: Task responsible
rowJSON.description: derived from RACI: the progress, the time sheet and the fact input of the task

rowJSON.title: Task manager
rowJSON.description: all task data except six disabled actions; how a person gets it is not decided yet

rowJSON.title: Financial manager (plan)
rowJSON.description: CRUD on the money plans: task lines and the payment plan

rowJSON.title: Financial manager (fact)
rowJSON.description: CRUD on the money fact documents
